description: For every formula \(A\), its actual definition list has at most \(3N(A)\) clauses and \(7N(A)\) literal occurrences.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.definitions_bounds.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.definitions A).length ≤
      3 * Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.treeSize A ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.literalCount
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.definitions A) ≤
      7 * Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.treeSize A
